airbnb.period: 2025-10-01 Inside Airbnb archive; last_scraped dates also reported
airbnb.provenance: User-supplied original Inside Airbnb detailed NYC extract

subway.period: Original user-supplied station extract; extract date unknown
subway.provenance: User-supplied original MTA Subway Stations CSV

income.period: 2019-2023 ACS 5-year estimates; tract median household income
income.provenance: Census Bureau official table-based summary file B19013

population.provenance: Census Bureau official table-based summary file B01003

tracts.period: 2023 TIGER/Line census tract boundaries, New York State

price_definition: Advertised nightly listing price, USD; not booked revenue or property sale value
distance_definition: Straight-line metres in EPSG:32618 to unique MTA subway station locations; SIR excluded
price_tail_filter: None: retain every finite positive price
notes: Income/population describe census tracts and do not measure individual hosts or guests.
ACS 2019-2023 estimates precede the listing snapshot; income margins of error are retained.
Station extract date is unknown. Straight-line access is not walking distance or travel time.
Staten Island listings can be far from the subway because SIR stations are excluded.
Listings without prices are excluded; observed prices may not represent all NYC listings.
Coordinates are approximate, so tract membership and station distance have measurement error.
primary_scope: Exclude Hotel room or property_type containing hotel, hostel, resort; no price-tail trimming
